entities.name: Adolph Reichsgraf von Ottweiler
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Adolf Ludwig Karl Moritz, Count of Ottweiler, was a member of the Princely House of Nassau-Saarbrücken, Count of Ottweiler, and a Lieutenant in the Army of Württemberg. He died as a volunteer in the Russian campaign.
